decision_conditions: Condition : 2 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of five years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 3 - Detailed drawings of the design and materials to be used in construction of the proposed extension (coping and roofing; pitch and type of slate; valley and connection detail; wall construction; replacement door; guttering) shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority before development commences and the development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any such approval.

Condition : 4 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details
description: Partial demolition of existing single storey bathroom and the erection of an additional single storey rear extension to form new bathroom, replacement of existing kitchen including new units and fittings, floor covering and full redecoration of existing dwellinghouse
